$comment: Non-localised store settings. Localised copy lives in metadata/<locale>/*.txt.
Contact identity verified against the developer’s existing Dynasty Manager App Store listing on 2026-09-09. See docs/RELEASE_SETUP.md.
$comment_categories: App Store Connect category identifiers, passed to the API verbatim. A game takes the
GAMES primary category plus up to two subcategories; Simulation is what this is, and
Strategy is the adjacent category its players browse. There is deliberately no
secondary category: the only honest candidates are other game categories, and a
second, weaker category dilutes the browse ranking of the first.
$comment_release: MANUAL controls publication of an approved version. Pre-order availability is configured separately in App Store Connect; see store/release-plan.json.
Release This Version publishes the pre-order only after every target territory is configured for pre-order.
$comment_screenshots: Display types Apple requires before a submission is accepted. These are the two
canvases everything else is scaled from; project.yml declares TARGETED_DEVICE_FAMILY
1,2, and shipping an iPad build is what makes the iPad row mandatory rather than a
nicety. The names are App Store Connect `screenshotDisplayType` enum values and are
passed to the API unchanged — see the TODO(verify) in scripts/asc/lib/metadata.mjs.
$comment_review: App Review's contact for this app. Apple will not accept a version without one, and
a wrong number is a rejection that costs a review cycle. demoAccountRequired is false
because the game has no accounts of any kind — see metadata/review/notes.txt.
